rationale: This release has earned a GO verdict on the strength of consistently high scores across all five assessment dimensions. Scope delivery stands at 95.8%, confirming the team delivered on its commitments. Estimation accuracy at -1% variance demonstrates a mature planning process. Environment provisioning is complete and stable, presenting no deployment risk. Test readiness — the highest-weighted dimension at 30% — shows a healthy test estate with no open blockers or critical defects. All upstream and downstream dependencies are complete and integration-validated. The aggregate confidence is high, with no dimensions missing and no required dimensions (Test Readiness, Environment) triggering mandatory unavailability gates. The minor risk factors identified (deferred story points, a small number of non-critical defects, two components pending final validation) are documented and accepted. There are no CRITICAL or MAJOR risk factors active, so no verdict caps are triggered. The release is ready to proceed with standard change management.
remediation: Complete environment validation sign-off for any components still in 'provisioned' state before the release window.
Ensure all open non-critical defects have a documented accepted-risk or deferred-to-next-sprint record in the defect tracker.
Update the release notes to capture the 3-5% of stories deferred to the next sprint, so stakeholders have a clear picture of what is and is not included.
Schedule a post-release retrospective within 5 business days to review estimation accuracy and scope-deferral patterns as inputs to next sprint planning.
